ranked.text: A failed or crashed Prefect flow run in forecast-pipeline caused retries, queueing, or resource contention that inflated the p95 duration.
Slow demand batch ingestion upstream made forecast-pipeline runs block or wait for input data.
Validation-gate data-quality warnings, specifically demand completeness or forecast stability, caused forecast-pipeline runs to stall, revalidate, or be retried.
Incomplete demand telemetry, where fewer than the four catalogued load zones reported demand, caused the pipeline to wait on or fail completeness processing.
A recent deployment or configuration change to forecast-pipeline or one of its related services introduced a latency regression that increased forecast-pipeline p95 duration.
